// N8N-OPS-04: Produce DR Verdict
const state = $input.first().json;

const output = {
  schema_version: state.schema_version,
  project_id: state.project_id,
  run_id: state.run_id,
  task_id: state.task_id,
  source: state.source,
  workflow: state.workflow,
  execution: { ...state.execution, completed_at: new Date().toISOString() },
  decision: state.decision,
  reason_codes: state.reason_codes,
  classification: state.decision === 'RESTORE_VERIFIED' ? 'GREEN' : 'RED',
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  dr_details: {
    backup_type: state.backup_type,
    restore_target: state.restore_target,
    test_instance_ctid: state.test_instance_ctid,
    production_ctid: state.production_ctid,
    backup: state.backup,
    restore_drill: state.restore_drill,
    credential_backup_separate: true,
    production_restore_performed: false,  // ALWAYS false
    network_egress_minimized: true
  }
};

return [{ json: output }];
